warnings: op1 direct read (house 13, Stage-2 SN-EE-M agent). Grid matches the master exactly: x-chain 1.10/3.50/3.50/1.10 against 1'(-1.10)/1(0)/2(3.50)/3(7.00)/3'(8.10); the plan's own dashed extension lines (perimeter storm-drain route, +0.40 note top-left corner) sit outside the 1-3 main grid, consistent with the 1'/3' dummy grids already recorded in the master from the S-04/S-05 beam plans.

A separate printed note reads 'ต้องการที่ดินกว้างอย่างน้อย = 11.10 ม.' (minimum required LOT width) above the grid dimension chain -- this is a minimum-plot-size guidance figure for this standard house design, not a mis-measured building dimension: building's own extended footprint (grid 1' to 3') is 9.20m, so 11.10m implies roughly a 0.95m side setback allowance each side beyond the building envelope. Recorded as printed, not treated as a discrepancy against the grid master.

Equipment cluster (septic tank, grease trap, water storage tank, auto pump, float valve) is drawn as one tight group at the ครัว/ซักล้าง corner near grid E3 with no individual dimension lines tying each item to an exact grid point -- grid_ref values are approximate (~) per the same convention used for stairs (spec §10a) and for this same equipment cluster on other houses in this series (e.g. house #10's SN-04).

บ่อพักท่อระบายน้ำสำเร็จรูป (storm-drain manholes, ⊠ symbol): only 2 instances carry the explicit '0.40x0.40ม.' label+leader on this sheet, but the ⊠ symbol itself repeats roughly 8 times around the full perimeter dashed line (both top corners, both sides at the B-row cleanouts, and both bottom corners near the A row/water meter) -- count intentionally NOT asserted as a specific number since the unlabeled repeats are small and not individually leadered; recording the type/size only and flagging per the same caution the project log records for a previous house's undercounted manhole run.

One room near the D-C x 2-3 area (labeled only '+0.50' with a toilet-fixture icon and a 'CO' cleanout symbol, no room-name text visible on this sanitary overlay) is inferred to be a ground-floor ห้องน้ำ/WC from its fixture icon and level, matching the equivalent room's position on the SN-06 enlarged WC detail (page 55) -- flagged since the room name itself is not printed on this particular sheet.
